summary: Full backend + frontend smoke of Panic Button. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass (auth register/login/me, profile, stats, abilities list/equip/lock, cosmetics list/equip/lock, match join/state/press/leave, progression persistence after leave). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): register on Auth screen navigates to Play menu, rank card + equipped ability visible, tab navigation works (Play/Rank/Abilities/Cosmetics/Stats), FIND MATCH pushes to Lobby with 8s countdown, Match HUD shows danger%, remaining count, elimination feed and panic button; pressing panic button eliminates other players and updates kills/protection counters. No React Native red screen. No deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch packages detected. Minor: (1) Custom TTF fonts fail to decode in Expo web preview (falls back to system font, non-blocking), (2) console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' from reveal overlay in match/[id].tsx line ~283.

issues: Custom fonts (IBMPlexSans-Regular/Medium/SemiBold/Bold) fail to decode on Expo web preview ('invalid sfntVersion'); text still renders via system fallback but display typography differs from native. Likely an assets-serving mimetype issue for TTF over the preview proxy; consider WOFF2 or loading via expo-font web-safe path.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses prop 'pointerEvents="none"' which triggers 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning. Reference: /app/frontend/app/match/[id].tsx:283

action_items: Migrate 'pointerEvents="none"' prop to 'style={{ pointerEvents: "none" }}' in /app/frontend/app/match/[id].tsx (~line 283) to silence React Native web deprecation warning.
Optional: investigate custom font decode failures over the Expo web preview proxy (font TTFs return HTML/incorrect content-type); either ship WOFF2 or rely on system font on web.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:307 CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject credentialed responses with wildcard; harmless today because JWT is sent in Authorization header (not a cookie), but consider tightening.
game.py: MatchManager keeps state in-process memory only; a backend restart drops live matches. Acceptable given problem scope (persistent progression stored in Mongo) but worth noting.
public_user only reads existing user doc; if 'equipped_cosmetics' or new stat fields are added later, back-fill defaults are handled inline via .get() — good.
config.py progression_snapshot: xp_into_level/xp_for_next are relative to current level floor — matches frontend XP bar computation.
seed_data_creation: Tests register throwaway users with TEST_ prefix + @panictest.io email; no manual seed data created. Primary test account (tester@panic.com / Test1234) in /app/memory/test_credentials.md was not required for tests but is available.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: https://panic-ranks.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Emails must use a real-looking domain (e.g. @panictest.io); pydantic EmailStr rejects @foo.test as reserved. Match join has 8s lobby countdown before phase becomes 'active' — poll GET /match/{id}/state for up to ~12s. Persistence after POST /match/{id}/leave is scheduled as a background asyncio task; poll GET /profile for a few seconds before asserting matches_played increment. Human can be randomly eliminated early (expected). Full match completion (100->1) can take minutes — do not wait for a natural end.
